prereq.p: Ensure the analyst account has been created with Technician role permissions and that access credentials have been securely delivered.

context.p: This procedure prepares a newly assigned technician to operate within FlowDesk. The onboarding process establishes platform familiarity, operational awareness, and compliance with service workflows.

step.cmd: Log in to FlowDesk using assigned credentials.

info.p: Verify successful authentication and role access.

step.cmd: Review the dashboard layout and ticket queue interface.

info.p: Identify assigned ticket panels, notification areas, and status indicators.

step.cmd: Open a sample ticket to examine lifecycle states and activity logs.

info.p: Observe how updates, timestamps, and audit entries are recorded.

step.cmd: Access the knowledge base and review existing troubleshooting articles.

info.p: Familiarize yourself with documentation standards and knowledge structure.

step.cmd: Simulate ticket workflow actions in a training or sandbox environment.

info.p: Practice assignment acknowledgment, status updates, and resolution logging.

step.cmd: Confirm understanding of escalation paths and priority handling.

info.p: Review internal procedures for high-impact incidents.

result.p: The analyst is prepared to receive and manage assigned tickets, apply operational procedures, and contribute to knowledge capture within FlowDesk.

postreq.p: Supervisors may validate onboarding completion through a guided review or operational readiness check.
